# Jadeel Madinat Jumeirah Living

> Jadeel is the third phase of Madinat Jumeirah Living, a low-rise residential community in Umm Suqeim 3, a short walk from Madinat Jumeirah and Burj Al Arab. The phase comprises three buildings, Jadeel 1 to 3, rising to between seven and ten storeys and holding one- to four-bedroom apartments. Residents share landscaped walkways, shaded courtyards, swimming pools, gyms, a community centre and basement parking. The buildings were handed over in 2025.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Umm Suqeim, Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed
- Year: 2025

## MENASCO Scope

Madinat Jumeirah Living Phase 3B comprises three residential buildings, Jadeel 1, 2 and 3, within Dubai Holding's Madinat Jumeirah Living community in Umm Suqeim, close to Burj Al Arab. MENASCO executed the complete MEP scope, covering engineering, supply, installation, testing and commissioning of HVAC, electrical, plumbing and firefighting systems, including centralised cooling and building automation. The phase was completed in 2025.
